coordinates.object_orientation: Spire +Z. Aperture faces front camera -Y; side +X, top +Z, perspective (+X,-Y,+Z). Consistent height/width across views.

concept.reason: Three actual museum views of the same specimen with millimeter ruler are sufficient; no additional concept image.

primary_specimen: MNHN.F.B03994, Gaudry collection; figured Gaudry 1883 p147 fig125
representation: Conservative fossil-shell interpretation, not exact undamaged facsimile

context.precision: Museum provides Devonian only; do not invent a formation or exact age.

dimensions.basis: Approximate image-ruler estimates from three views of B03994, not museum-reported measurements. Height about20-21mm; width10-11mm; depth approximately10mm. Allow about1mm uncertainty.

scope: Original Devonian fossil high-spire target; one specimen supplies morphology and scale. Preserve moderately tall conical spire and circumferential shoulders; do not exaggerate into needle shell or borrow other species proportions.
must_preserve: About six visible whorls, tapering apex; shell height roughly twice maximum width.
Stepped whorl shoulders with low continuous spiral keel/band; sculpture visibly worn, not giant spikes or deep isolated grooves.
Inflated last whorl and narrower preceding whorls, following all three genuine photos.
Front-facing aperture with conservative thin rim; edge is locally damaged despite museum condition label complet. Keep aperture repair disclosed, not claimed observed.
Neutral pale fossil calcite tone; no specimen ink, ruler or black background modeled.
forbidden: Copy source photo as texture or import third-party mesh
Mix another specimen scale, modern shell or non-Devonian morphology
Assert exact intact aperture, slit length or protoconch anatomy
Over-sharpen worn keel or add axial spikes
